description: Figure 3 presents a donut-style pie chart illustrating the distribution of different input stimulus material types provided by journalists to LLMs. The chart features a central hole displaying the bolded text "Stimulus Type" and is divided into ten distinct slices. Moving clockwise from the top right, the categories, their corresponding colors, and percentages are as follows: "Draft/Other" in dark red (26.4%), "Event Posting" in orange (6.6%), "Organizational Report" in light purple (7.7%), "Organizational Website" in dark purple (4.9%), "Interview" in dark blue (8.8%), "Intra-agency news article" in teal (4.9%), "External News Article" in dark green (18.1%), "Email" in light green (2.7%), "Press Release" in yellow (18.7%), and "Social Media Post" in orange-red (1.1%). The chart does not include a separate legend; instead, the category labels and their exact percentage values are positioned outside the chart and connected to their respective slices via thin callout lines. None of the segments are visually emphasized through explosion or offsetting, and the slices do not appear to be ordered by size in either an ascending or descending manner.
